labels.name: enhancement
labels.rationale: Asks for a wider type on Table.title, which needs new code; a feature request under the feature template.

body:
This request is the same as #4171, which was closed as not planned. New features need approval in [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) before an issue is opened, so if you want to pursue a wider `Table.title` type, please start the discussion there and link this report.

`Table.title` is typed as `TextType` and rendered as text, so a `Rule` cannot be passed in directly today. See [`rich/table.py`](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/rich/table.py) for the current definition.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
